description:
Java class defining an abstract provider for signal enrichment related to connectivity, loaded dynamically via reflection in an Akka actor system.
It includes methods for obtaining a facade given a connection ID and for dynamically loading an implementation based on configuration.

classes.name: ConnectivitySignalEnrichmentProvider
classes.description: An abstract class providing method definitions for creating signal enrichment facades based on connection IDs and a static method for loading providers dynamically.

methods.name: getFacade
methods.description: Abstract method to create a SignalEnrichmentFacade based on a ConnectionId.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to retrieve an instance of ConnectivitySignalEnrichmentProvider by loading configuration and extension from the specified ActorSystem.
